message.reasoning:
We need to fix test failure: when schema node contains "$dynamicAnchor": true, JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance().getSchema(node) returns schema with dynamicAnchor false. So maybe the library expects "$dynamicAnchor" keyword under "$defs"? Actually dynamic anchor is a keyword defined in JSON Schema spec, used in "$dynamicAnchor". The library may not support it unless the schema version is set to draft-2020-12 or later. Maybe need to set validation context with appropriate spec version. The test code uses default factory which may default to draft-7 (no dynamicAnchor). To make it recognize, we need to configure JsonSchemaFactory with appropriate version: e.g., JsonSchemaFactory.builder().setVersion(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012).freeze(). Or similar.

Let's inspect library. In networknt json-schema-validator, there is JsonSchemaFactory with methods: getInstance() returns default instance (draft v4?). There is also getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag). Actually there is a builder: JsonSchemaFactory.builder().setMetaSchema(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012).freeze().

Thus modify test to use factory that supports dynamic anchor. The test code is part of test suite; we can adjust creation method createJsonSchema and other usages to use a factory with appropriate spec version.

Simplify: create a static final JsonSchemaFactory factory = JsonSchemaFactory.builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance()).setMetaSchema(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012).freeze(); Or builder without base.

Let's search memory: In networknt json-schema-validator, there is enum SpecVersion.VersionFlag with values V4, V6, V7, V201909, V202012. So we can use JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012). Not sure if method exists.

But easier: use JsonSchemaFactory.builder().setSpecVersion(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012).freeze(). Let's assume builder has method setSpecVersion.

We'll adjust code: add import com.networknt.schema.SpecVersion; import com.networknt.schema.JsonSchemaFactory; Then modify createJsonSchema to use factory with V202012.

Also adjust other tests that use JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance().

Implement a private static final JsonSchemaFactory factory = JsonSchemaFactory.builder(JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance()).setSpecVersion(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012).freeze();

Or builder().setMetaSchema(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012).freeze().

Let's check typical usage: In networknt json-schema-validator, they use JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V201909). So there is overloaded getInstance that takes VersionFlag. So we can simply use JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012). That returns a factory configured.

Thus modify all calls: JsonSchemaFactory.getInstance(SpecVersion.VersionFlag.V202012).getSchema(...)

Let's adjust code accordingly.

Also need imports.

Let's produce corrected code.
